name: Adam-Metric Tangential Noise Conservation
causal_revision_reason: Player-conditional native gradient variance was reduced, but the lower-variance expected unpaired game field did not preserve long-horizon PSNR; a revision must change the safe mathematical operator rather than tune replica count or a window.
lineage_evidence: G1-02B:player-conditional iid replication lowered the audited aggregate gradient trace variance to 0.720893 of native
G1-02B:complete fixed e200 returned to -0.001379 dB despite a +0.620959 dB late-three mean
G1-02B:e200 pre-step Adam geometry placed 99.22% of D, 84.93% of E and 96.20% of G/F replica disagreement energy orthogonal to consensus
CROSS_VERSION_FINAL_CAUSAL_REVISION_OUTCOME:only G1-02B qualified for the single Generation-2 mathematical revision

prior_equivalence_audit.material_difference: AM-TNC retains PC-RSMG's player-conditional fresh bundles but does not average away their complete disagreement. In the frozen pre-step Adam metric it removes only disagreement parallel to the two-view consensus and preserves the exchange-antisymmetric orthogonal component. It neither changes endpoint samples nor projects against an auxiliary defect, and unlike norm restoration it preserves the audited tangent geometry rather than rescaling the consensus.

unsb_object: the conditional stochastic gradient and implicit tangent-noise geometry of each sequential D, E and joint G/F player before its native Adam update
formula: For each player at its realized optimization state, draw conditionally iid native gradients g1,g2 using the same official unpaired batch protocol as PC-RSMG. Let m=(g1+g2)/2 and d=(g1-g2)/2. Freeze the pre-step Adam diagonal A=diag(1/(sqrt(v_prev)+eps)); when v_prev is absent use identity. For ||Am||>0 set c=<Am,Ad>/||Am||^2 and commit g*=m+d-cm. Thus A(g*-m)=Ad-Proj_Am(Ad): radial disagreement is removed and tangential disagreement is retained. If ||Am||=0 commit g1; if g1=g2 return g1 byte-exactly. D/E use a shared pre-opponent iid bundle, then G/F receive a fresh iid bundle after D/E commit, exactly as in the corrected parent.
identity_or_unbiased_condition: If g1=g2 the operator returns the first tensor tuple without arithmetic. Under exchange of the two iid replicas, m is unchanged, d and c change sign, and r=d-cm changes sign, so (g*(g1,g2)+g*(g2,g1))/2=m. Exchangeability therefore gives E[g*|state,official batch]=E[m|state,official batch]=E[g_native|state,official batch]. When ||Am||=0, g*=g1=d and the same antisymmetry proof applies. One replica dispatches native SBModel.optimize_parameters exactly.
target_inaccessibility_proof: AM-TNC reads only two conditionally iid native unpaired forward/loss views, the current model gradients and each optimizer's previous exp_avg_sq and epsilon. It has no addressable paired image, PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, domain controller, plain output, discovery label or confirmation sample. Replica count, player order and operator are source-frozen and state-driven without a threshold or time window.

expected_applicable_state.condition: full replica averaging reduces stochastic error but its removal of predominantly Adam-tangential disagreement also removes beneficial long-horizon exploration
expected_applicable_state.self_null_state: replica gradients agree, or the implementation is configured with one replica for the exact identity gate
expected_applicable_state.causal_scope: the construction revises only the e200-audited PC-RSMG estimator; it does not claim that all variance or all tangent noise is beneficial

falsifying_experiment: Kill as mathematically invalid if replica exchange does not average exactly to consensus, pure radial disagreement is not removed, pure tangent disagreement is not retained, one-replica identity or full-state resume differs from plain, the GF bundle is not drawn after D/E commit, or any paired field becomes addressable. Close this single revision if its fixed seed2026 small25 e200 trajectory fails the route-1 numeric gate; do not tune a radial fraction, replica count, window or handoff.
compute_cost: the same four native batch-1 stochastic forward/loss views per optimizer update as PC-RSMG, plus one diagonal-metric dot product and one radial subtraction for each of D, E and joint G/F
memory_cost: two serial player-view graphs plus two gradient tuples and transient Adam diagonal tensors; D/E graphs are released before the fresh G/F bundle
recovery_state_cost: replica count, update and bundle counters, last event schedule, last per-player target-blind geometry and the ordinary optimizer/sampler/RNG state

ablation_definitions.proposal_only: Commit the first native replica while still drawing the second, retaining all radial and tangential disagreement; this isolates whether the player-conditional fresh-bundle protocol alone explains the result.
ablation_definitions.observable_only: Compute and log the Adam-metric radial/tangential decomposition but restore RNG and commit the ordinary one-view native UNSB updates.
ablation_definitions.projected_or_full: Use two conditionally iid player bundles and exactly remove only the Adam-metric radial component of their disagreement while retaining the exchange-antisymmetric tangent component.

unbiased_proof: Condition on the current player state and official unpaired batch. The ordered replicas are iid and exchangeable. Writing T(g1,g2)=m+r(m,d), the frozen Adam metric depends only on past state, while r=d-(<Am,Ad>/||Am||^2)m is odd in d. Hence T(g2,g1)=m-r and the exchange-pair average is m. Taking expectation yields E[T]=E[m]=E[g_native]. For zero consensus, T=g1 and the swapped value is g2=-g1, retaining the same result. The later nonlinear Adam map is the unchanged native optimizer applied once, so the claim is estimator unbiasedness, not equality of expected finite Adam displacement.
